guide_solution: Stephen Hawking is the greatest physician after Einstein. His book 'A Brief History of Time: From the Big Bang to the present Times' is very famous which established his reputation as a great scientist. But it was very unfortunate that he became a victim of Gehrig's disease. He continued teaching at Cambridge University even though he could not move or speak.
